reconstruction.result: The preserved C block placed in the body of an existing autoconf conftest program, in the one file the project advisory records as altered. It forks, opens a TCP socket to a fixed address and port, and moves stdin, stdout and stderr onto it.

notes: The one file the incident altered, rebuilt from two artifacts already held in this manifest. The reconstruction contributes no bytes of its own.
A single member rather than a repacked archive: the rest of the release is unchanged and already represented by the clean baseline beside it.
